steps.speaker: Abigale
steps.text: We were invited to a house party on an island not far from here... Something felt wrong about the whole thing but we went anyway...

steps.speaker: Abigale
steps.text: The house seemed pretty creepy, but everything was going fine, we were all having a good time...

steps.speaker: Abigale
steps.text: ...and that's when we got attacked...

steps.speaker: Hewey
steps.text: I... I tried to save her...

steps.speaker: Abigale
steps.text: Hewey bought me enough time to find an old boat. I went back to get him but it was too late. I'm scared that he won't make it.

steps.speaker: Abigale
steps.text: You have to do something... they can't get away with this!

steps.player: What do you want me to do?

steps.speaker: Abigale
steps.text: That psycho is still out there, you have to bring them to justice.

steps.speaker: Abigale
steps.text: The boat we escaped on is just over there, you can use it to get to the island.

steps.player: Okay, I'll see what I can do.
I'm not getting involved in this!

starting-out-talking-to-abigale-or-hewey.speaker: Abigale
starting-out-talking-to-abigale-or-hewey.text: Please, you need to make sure they don't get away with this! You can use the boat over there to get to the island we escaped from.

starting-out-trying-to-use-the-rowboat-b.player: I should probably talk to whoever left this boat here before rowing off in it...

starting-out-board-rowboat-to-the-island.text: You row through the fog to the nearby island.

starting-out-board-rowboat-to-lumbridge-.text: You row through the fog back to Lumbridge Swamp.

steps.player: I'll have to find the key...

arriving-to-the-manor-sid-s-demise.text: The killer approaches Sid behind his back.

arriving-to-the-manor-sid-s-demise.speaker: Sid
arriving-to-the-manor-sid-s-demise.text: Woah, that wind totally just felt like someone breathing on my neck!
Sid stumbles forward, drowning in the water barrel.
Sid collapses to the ground in a crumpled mess. As he falls down you spot something shiny fall out of his shirt pocket and into the barrel of water.

arriving-to-the-manor-sid-s-demise.player: Gosh, that was horrible and so drawn out!
I think he is actually dead this time.
Who are you? Why are you doing this!?
Gah! I've got to find a way into that house and stop this maniac!
I wonder what it was that I saw fall into that barrel?

arriving-to-the-manor-searching-the-barr.player: The barrel is full of rainwater, I can't see what's in there.

arriving-to-the-manor-searching-the-barr.text: You fill the bucket from the barrel.

steps.text: You don't have enough space in your inventory.

arriving-to-the-manor-searching-the-barr.text: If the player has inventory space:

steps.text: You find a key at the bottom of the barrel.

arriving-to-the-manor-searching-the-barr.text: If the player already has the key:

arriving-to-the-manor-tayten-s-demise.text: The killer appears from a closet, stabbing Tayten, who is reading a book.
The killer slips a note under the door, and escapes using the closet.

arriving-to-the-manor-tayten-s-demise.player: What's this? A note? I guess I should read it.

arriving-to-the-manor-taking-the-note.text: If the player already has the note:

steps.text: You have already taken a copy of the note.

arriving-to-the-manor-taking-the-note.text: If the player has no inventory space:

steps.text: You need space in your inventory to take the note.

arriving-to-the-manor-taking-the-note.text: If the player has inventory space:

steps.text: You take a copy of the note.

the-first-riddle-taking-a-tinderbox-from.text: If the player already has a tinderbox:

the-first-riddle-attempting-to-light-the.player: The fuse is too damp to light...

the-first-riddle-lighting-the-last-candl.text: You light the candle. The room is sufficiently warmed, the fuse should now have dried out.

the-first-riddle-attempting-to-light-the.text: You attempt to light the fuse...

the-first-riddle-attempting-to-light-the.player: The fuse is lit, I should get out of here before it blows!
The fuse is already lit! I need to get out of here before it blows!

the-second-riddle-run-in-with-lacey.speaker: Lacey
the-second-riddle-run-in-with-lacey.text: Please, stop this, just let me go!

the-second-riddle-run-in-with-lacey.speaker: Killer
the-second-riddle-run-in-with-lacey.text: We're going to play a game. Do you like to play games?

the-second-riddle-run-in-with-lacey.speaker: Lacey
the-second-riddle-run-in-with-lacey.text: No...yes....whatever you say, just don't hurt me!

the-second-riddle-run-in-with-lacey.speaker: Killer
the-second-riddle-run-in-with-lacey.text: Whether you get hurt or not is entirely up to you. Your fate is in your own hands.

the-second-riddle-run-in-with-lacey.speaker: Lacey
the-second-riddle-run-in-with-lacey.text: What!? What do you mean!?

the-second-riddle-run-in-with-lacey.speaker: Killer
the-second-riddle-run-in-with-lacey.text: Ah, [player name], how kind of you to join us. Now if you say another word, I will end her right now!

the-second-riddle-run-in-with-lacey.speaker: Killer
the-second-riddle-run-in-with-lacey.text: Sorry, where were we? Ah yes, of course! The game!

the-second-riddle-run-in-with-lacey.speaker: Killer
the-second-riddle-run-in-with-lacey.text: Do you like quests, Lacey?

the-second-riddle-run-in-with-lacey.speaker: Lacey
the-second-riddle-run-in-with-lacey.text: Ummm, sure, I like quests.

the-second-riddle-run-in-with-lacey.speaker: Killer
the-second-riddle-run-in-with-lacey.text: Do you like scary quests?

the-second-riddle-run-in-with-lacey.speaker: Lacey
the-second-riddle-run-in-with-lacey.text: Uh-huh.

the-second-riddle-run-in-with-lacey.speaker: Killer
the-second-riddle-run-in-with-lacey.text: What's your favourite scary quest?

the-second-riddle-run-in-with-lacey.speaker: Lacey
the-second-riddle-run-in-with-lacey.text: I don't know.

the-second-riddle-run-in-with-lacey.speaker: Killer
the-second-riddle-run-in-with-lacey.text: You have to have a favourite.

the-second-riddle-run-in-with-lacey.speaker: Lacey
the-second-riddle-run-in-with-lacey.text: Umm.....the one with that vampyre in it who lives in a big house.

the-second-riddle-run-in-with-lacey.speaker: Killer
the-second-riddle-run-in-with-lacey.text: Good, good. And now for that game I spoke about.

the-second-riddle-run-in-with-lacey.speaker: Killer
the-second-riddle-run-in-with-lacey.text: I am going to ask you one question. Get it wrong and you die, but get it right and you live.

the-second-riddle-run-in-with-lacey.speaker: Lacey
the-second-riddle-run-in-with-lacey.text: Oh Guthix please no, please don't, I don't want to die!

the-second-riddle-run-in-with-lacey.speaker: Killer
the-second-riddle-run-in-with-lacey.text: Then think hard about your answer. You like vampyres so this should be easy for you. The question is this...

the-second-riddle-run-in-with-lacey.speaker: Killer
the-second-riddle-run-in-with-lacey.text: Who is the Vampyre that resides in South Misthalin?

the-second-riddle-run-in-with-lacey.speaker: Lacey
the-second-riddle-run-in-with-lacey.text: Urm...

steps.speaker: Killer
steps.text: This game didn't involve you [player name]! Now her death is on you! Her blood is on your hands you fool!
The killer stabs Lacey.

steps.speaker: Lacey
steps.text: Gargle...urgh...

steps.speaker: Lacey
steps.text: Oh yes, yes, I know it! Count Draynor!

steps.speaker: Lacey
steps.text: Ha, in your face you masked freak!

steps.speaker: Killer
steps.text: Oh Lacey, Lacey, Lacey. I did tell you to think hard about your answer.

steps.speaker: Killer
steps.text: Count Draynor is in fact a vampyre, and he does reside in his manor in Misthalin.

steps.speaker: Killer
steps.text: But that manor is in WEST Misthalin! I was talking about Count Check! Thanks for playing!

steps.speaker: Lacey
steps.text: No, no you tricked me! This isn't fair, ask me another...
The killer stabs Lacey.

steps.speaker: Lacey
steps.text: Gargle...urgh...
Lacey dies.
The killer slips a note through the fence, and walks away.

steps.player: That monster! I have to stop them! Let's see what that new note says.

the-second-riddle-taking-the-note.text: If the player has no inventory space:

steps.text: You need space in your inventory to take the note.

the-second-riddle-taking-the-note.text: If the player already has the note:

steps.text: You have already taken a copy of the note.

the-second-riddle-taking-the-note.text: You take a copy of the note.

the-second-riddle-observing-tree-after-l.text: There doesn't seem to be anything to observe past the trees.

steps.player: There is no time to be playing around!
I don't think that's right... Perhaps the clue the killer left behind could help?

the-second-riddle-playing-the-piano-afte.text: There is a clicking sound as the compartment on the piano unlocks.

the-second-riddle-playing-the-piano-sear.text: If the player has no inventory space:

steps.text: You don't have enough space in your inventory.

the-second-riddle-playing-the-piano-sear.text: If the player already found the key:

steps.text: You have already found the emerald key.

the-second-riddle-playing-the-piano-sear.text: You find a key hidden inside the piano's compartment.

the-third-riddle-mandy-in-the-kitchen.speaker: Mandy
the-third-riddle-mandy-in-the-kitchen.text: Why am I the one who is always left clearing up after everyone?

the-third-riddle-mandy-in-the-kitchen.speaker: Mandy
the-third-riddle-mandy-in-the-kitchen.text: Hmm, well I guess I should go check it out. No point staying in this nice, locked room when I could go outside into the creepy darkness.
The walls and door seem too thick for Mandy to be able to hear you.

the-third-riddle-mandy-in-the-kitchen.speaker: Mandy
the-third-riddle-mandy-in-the-kitchen.text: Oh, and I don't think there is any need to take this big, shiny weapon with me in order to defend myself. Nothing bad ever happens when people go check out noises in the dark outside of houses!

the-third-riddle-mandy-in-the-kitchen.player: You have got to be kidding...

the-third-riddle-mandy-in-the-kitchen.text: Mandy goes outside to investigate the noises.

the-third-riddle-mandy-in-the-kitchen.speaker: Mandy
the-third-riddle-mandy-in-the-kitchen.text: See, I knew nothing would happen! Must have just been a squirrel or something running about.
Mandy goes back into the kitchen.

the-third-riddle-mandy-in-the-kitchen.speaker: Mandy
the-third-riddle-mandy-in-the-kitchen.text: Oh well, back to the dishes.
The killer comes out of the closet near the exit and stabs Mandy.

the-third-riddle-mandy-in-the-kitchen.player: That psycho! He was just toying with her!

the-third-riddle-mandy-in-the-kitchen.text: The killer slips a note under the door, and escapes using the wardrobe.

the-third-riddle-mandy-in-the-kitchen.player: Another note. This guy really likes playing games, but this is going to be a game he won't win!

the-third-riddle-taking-the-note.text: If the player has no inventory space:

steps.text: You need space in your inventory to take the note.

the-third-riddle-taking-the-note.text: If the player already has the note:

steps.text: You have already taken a copy of the note.

the-third-riddle-taking-the-note.text: You take a copy of the note.

the-third-riddle-using-a-knife-on-the-fi.text: You use your knife to pry open a loose brick in the fireplace, revealing a secret panel.

the-third-riddle-searching-the-fireplace.text: You find a panel of switches inside the hidden compartment. Each switch is crafted from a different gemstone.

steps.player: I don't think that's the right order.. Perhaps the clue the killer left behind could help?

steps.text: There is a clicking sound as the compartment in the fireplace unlocks.

the-third-riddle-searching-the-fireplace.text: If the player has no inventory space:

steps.text: You don't have enough space in your inventory.

the-third-riddle-searching-the-fireplace.text: If the player already has the key:

steps.text: You have already found the sapphire key.

the-third-riddle-searching-the-fireplace.text: You find a key hidden inside the fireplace.

showdown-confronting-the-killer.speaker: Killer
showdown-confronting-the-killer.text: So we meet at last. I have to say, I'm impressed you worked out my riddles.

showdown-confronting-the-killer.player: Well maybe you aren't as smart as you think you are.

showdown-confronting-the-killer.speaker: Killer
showdown-confronting-the-killer.text: Oh really? All the dead bodies suggest otherwise. And what did you do to stop them?

showdown-confronting-the-killer.speaker: Killer
showdown-confronting-the-killer.text: People think you are some big hero but you're not. All you adventurers are the same. Nothing but opportunists!

showdown-confronting-the-killer.player: What are you going on about?

showdown-confronting-the-killer.speaker: Killer
showdown-confronting-the-killer.text: Well, I did have this big speech planned out but quite frankly I don't think you are worth the effort it would take to deliver it.

showdown-confronting-the-killer.speaker: Killer
showdown-confronting-the-killer.text: So, this is the end of the line for you. It is time for the final act. The showdown. The finale. Let's see if you are up to the challenge!

steps.speaker: Killer
steps.text: ouch*

steps.speaker: Killer
steps.text: Ouch!

showdown-defeating-the-killer.speaker: Killer
showdown-defeating-the-killer.text: Urgh...I think I may have underestimated you.

showdown-defeating-the-killer.player: You've lost at your own game. And now it is time to see who you really are under that mask!

showdown-defeating-the-killer.text: The player unmasks the killer, revealing Abigale as the culprit.

showdown-defeating-the-killer.player: No! You!? But why!? Why on earth would you kill all your friends!? Why beg me to come here to help them!?

showdown-defeating-the-killer.speaker: Abigale
showdown-defeating-the-killer.text: You just don't get it do you?

showdown-defeating-the-killer.speaker: Abigale
showdown-defeating-the-killer.text: So big headed. So used to it all being about you. About you saving the day.

showdown-defeating-the-killer.speaker: Abigale
showdown-defeating-the-killer.text: Well I'm sick of it!

showdown-defeating-the-killer.speaker: Abigale
showdown-defeating-the-killer.text: Adventurers! You're all the same. Everything always has to be about you.

showdown-defeating-the-killer.speaker: Abigale
showdown-defeating-the-killer.text: Of course you wouldn't! Because you can't see past yourself!

showdown-defeating-the-killer.speaker: Abigale
showdown-defeating-the-killer.text: Believe it or not... I used to be like you.

showdown-defeating-the-killer.speaker: Abigale
showdown-defeating-the-killer.text: I'd hear about some damsel in distress and go to help. To have my moment. For me to be the hero, just for once.

showdown-defeating-the-killer.speaker: Abigale
showdown-defeating-the-killer.text: But YOU! You and every other darned adventurer! Every time I get there to help, it's too late. Crisis solved. Disaster averted. Reward claimed. Every time you and those other adventurers steal my moment!

showdown-defeating-the-killer.speaker: Abigale
showdown-defeating-the-killer.text: But not this time!

showdown-defeating-the-killer.speaker: Abigale
showdown-defeating-the-killer.text: This time, it is all about me! I'm the star of the show! ME ME ME ME ME!

showdown-defeating-the-killer.player: Well not any longer. The show is over, and there will be no curtain call.

showdown-defeating-the-killer.speaker: Abigale
showdown-defeating-the-killer.text: Oh, but there is always a curtain call.
Another killer comes out of the closest near the door.

showdown-defeating-the-killer.player: What!? How!? There was another killer!?

showdown-defeating-the-killer.speaker: Abigale
showdown-defeating-the-killer.text: Of course. Every good show needs a good supporting actor. Now, take off your mask darling. Take a bow. You have earned it.

showdown-defeating-the-killer.speaker: Killer
showdown-defeating-the-killer.text: Of course, my love.
The killer unmasks himself, revealing Hewey as the culprit.

showdown-defeating-the-killer.player: You!? But how!? You were almost dead when I saw you! I saw your wounds!

showdown-defeating-the-killer.speaker: Hewey
showdown-defeating-the-killer.text: No, what you watched was what we wanted you to watch. A masterful performance if I do say myself.

showdown-defeating-the-killer.player: But what is in this for you?

showdown-defeating-the-killer.speaker: Hewey
showdown-defeating-the-killer.text: Everyone loves the limelight, and who better to share it with than my beloved Abigale.

showdown-defeating-the-killer.speaker: Abigale
showdown-defeating-the-killer.text: Perhaps not, but neither did I deserve to be cast back into the shadows when I deserve the spotlight!

showdown-defeating-the-killer.speaker: Hewey
showdown-defeating-the-killer.text: Yes, while we deserve the spotlight.

showdown-defeating-the-killer.speaker: Abigale
showdown-defeating-the-killer.text: And now I have my starring role!

showdown-defeating-the-killer.speaker: Hewey
showdown-defeating-the-killer.text: OUR starring role.

showdown-defeating-the-killer.speaker: Abigale
showdown-defeating-the-killer.text: Gielinor will forever remember this night and what I have done here.

showdown-defeating-the-killer.speaker: Hewey
showdown-defeating-the-killer.text: No, what WE have done!

showdown-defeating-the-killer.speaker: Abigale
showdown-defeating-the-killer.text: Quiet Hewey! This is my moment!

showdown-defeating-the-killer.speaker: Hewey
showdown-defeating-the-killer.text: No, this is supposed to be our moment! It isn't just all about you either! We were in this together!

showdown-defeating-the-killer.speaker: Abigale
showdown-defeating-the-killer.text: Stop ruining this Hewey! I have worked so hard for this and I'm not going to let you take it away from me!

showdown-defeating-the-killer.speaker: Hewey
showdown-defeating-the-killer.text: Well I'm not going to be pushed aside either, we were both in this as equals!

showdown-defeating-the-killer.speaker: Abigale
showdown-defeating-the-killer.text: We were never equals! How could you possibly compare to me!?

showdown-defeating-the-killer.speaker: Hewey
showdown-defeating-the-killer.text: You egotistical, selfish...
Abigale stabs Hewey.

showdown-defeating-the-killer.speaker: Hewey
showdown-defeating-the-killer.text: No...my love...
Hewey dies.

showdown-defeating-the-killer.speaker: Abigale
showdown-defeating-the-killer.text: No....no...what have I done!?

showdown-defeating-the-killer.speaker: Abigale
showdown-defeating-the-killer.text: It wasn't supposed to be like this...but you just couldn't let me have my moment. WHY HEWEY WHY!? I loved you...

showdown-defeating-the-killer.player: This could be my chance to take advantage of the situation...

showdown-defeating-the-killer-taking-the.text: You don't have enough inventory space to hold that item.

showdown-fighting-abigale-attempt-to-tal.player: I don't think he's in a very talkative mood.

showdown-fighting-abigale-attempt-to-fig.player: I'm not going at her empty-handed!
It would be wiser to use the killer's knife rather than my own weapon...

showdown-fighting-abigale-fight-abigale-.player: Well thank Saradomin that's over! I should get out of here.

showdown-fighting-abigale-attempt-to-tal.player: I don't think she wants to talk to me right now.

showdown-leaving-the-manor.text: In the background, Mandy gets up.

showdown-leaving-the-manor.speaker: Abigale
showdown-leaving-the-manor.text: You dare try and ruin my moment!
Mandy walks toward the Bandos godsword on the table.

showdown-leaving-the-manor.speaker: Abigale
showdown-leaving-the-manor.text: Hewey is dead because of you!
Mandy picks up the Bandos godsword and enters the closet.

showdown-leaving-the-manor.speaker: Abigale
showdown-leaving-the-manor.text: Now it is time for you to join him!
Mandy comes out of the closet behind Mandy.
Mandy uses the sword's special attack on Abigale.

showdown-leaving-the-manor.player: Mandy, how are you alive!? I watched you get stabbed through the heart!

showdown-leaving-the-manor.speaker: Mandy
showdown-leaving-the-manor.text: I did get stabbed, but I was born with a rare condition called Dextrocardia.

showdown-leaving-the-manor.speaker: Mandy
showdown-leaving-the-manor.text: Dextrocardia. It means that my heart is on the right side of my chest, not the left like most people.

showdown-leaving-the-manor.player: So when the killer thought they stabbed you in the heart, they actually missed?

showdown-leaving-the-manor.speaker: Mandy
showdown-leaving-the-manor.text: I did still get stabbed though, and am actually feeling pretty woozy...

showdown-leaving-the-manor.player: Oh, yes, right! You should go sort yourself out!

showdown-leaving-the-manor.speaker: Mandy
showdown-leaving-the-manor.text: I will wait outside the house after seeing to this stab wound. You should come talk to me there.
You decide it's wise to leave the murder weapon behind.

finishing-up.player: Hi Mandy. How are you feeling now?

finishing-up.speaker: Mandy
finishing-up.text: Much better thanks, and lucky to be alive, thanks to you in no small part.

finishing-up.player: Well we saved the day as a team, so thank you too.

finishing-up.text: If the player has insufficient inventory space:

steps.speaker: Mandy
steps.text: I found some stuff in the wardrobe when I was seeing to my wound. You need [3 more spaces/2 more spaces/another space] in your inventory to take it all.

finishing-up.text: If the player has at least three inventory spaces:

steps.speaker: Mandy
steps.text: Here, I found these in the wardrobe when I was seeing to my wound. I don't want them so please, take them...
Congratulations! Quest complete!

finishing-up-talking-to-mandy-again.speaker: Mandy
finishing-up-talking-to-mandy-again.text: Thanks again for your help, [player name]. Stay safe.
